cases.question: 2026년 6월 호텔별 객실 점유율, ADR, RevPAR와 인식 객실매출을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT hotel_code, sum(rooms_sold) AS rooms_sold, sum(available_room_nights) AS available_room_nights, sum(recognized_room_revenue) AS recognized_room_revenue, CAST(sum(rooms_sold) AS double) / nullif(sum(available_room_nights), 0) AS occupancy_rate, CAST(sum(stay_day_room_revenue) AS double) / nullif(sum(rooms_sold), 0) AS adr, CAST(sum(stay_day_room_revenue) AS double) / nullif(sum(available_room_nights), 0) AS revpar FROM serving.analytics.v4_hotel_daily_metrics WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY hotel_code ORDER BY hotel_code

cases.question: 2026년 6월 체크인 예약의 채널·시장 세그먼트별 취소율과 취소 예약금액을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT booking_channel, market_segment, count(*) AS reservation_count, count_if(reservation_status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_count, CAST(count_if(reservation_status = 'CANCELLED') AS double) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS cancellation_rate, sum(CASE WHEN reservation_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN booked_amount ELSE DECIMAL '0' END) AS cancelled_booked_amount FROM pms.walkerhill_v4.pms_reservations WHERE checkin_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND checkin_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY booking_channel, market_segment ORDER BY booking_channel, market_segment

cases.question: 2026년 6월 업장·서비스 시간대별 순매출, covers, 객단가와 RevPASH를 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT outlet_id, service_period, sum(order_count) AS order_count, sum(fnb_covers) AS fnb_covers, sum(fnb_net_revenue) AS fnb_net_revenue, CAST(sum(fnb_net_revenue) AS double) / nullif(sum(fnb_covers), 0) AS average_check, CAST(sum(fnb_net_revenue) AS double) / nullif(sum(available_seat_hours), 0) AS revpash FROM serving.analytics.v4_fnb_daily_metrics WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY outlet_id, service_period ORDER BY outlet_id, service_period

cases.question: 2026년 6월 거래일 당시 회원등급과 원천별 기여매출을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT h.tier_code, r.source_domain, count(DISTINCT r.member_no) AS member_count, sum(r.transaction_count) AS transaction_count, sum(r.revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount FROM serving.analytics.v4_member_daily_revenue_metrics r JOIN crm.walkerhill_v4.crm_member_grade_history h ON r.member_no = h.member_no AND h.valid_from <= r.business_date AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR r.business_date < h.valid_to) WHERE r.business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND r.business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY h.tier_code, r.source_domain ORDER BY h.tier_code, r.source_domain

cases.question: 2026년 7월 1일 직전 기준 회원별 포인트 원장 합계와 현재 잔액의 불일치 건수를 검증해줘.
cases.sql: WITH ledger AS (SELECT member_no, sum(points_delta) AS ledger_balance FROM crm.walkerhill_v4.crm_point_transactions WHERE event_at < from_iso8601_timestamp('2026-07-01T00:00:00+09:00') GROUP BY member_no) SELECT count(*) AS member_count, count_if(m.points_balance <> coalesce(l.ledger_balance, 0)) AS mismatch_count, sum(abs(m.points_balance - coalesce(l.ledger_balance, 0))) AS absolute_point_gap FROM crm.walkerhill_v4.crm_members m LEFT JOIN ledger l ON m.member_no = l.member_no

cases.question: 2026년 6월 행사 유형별 문의·견적·확정·완료·취소 funnel을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT event_type, count(*) AS inquiry_count, count_if(quoted_at IS NOT NULL) AS quoted_count, count_if(confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS confirmed_count, count_if(booking_status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count, count_if(booking_status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_count FROM banquet.walkerhill_v4.banquet_bookings WHERE event_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type

cases.question: 2026년 6월 연회장별 참석자, 인식매출과 객실 block pickup을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT venue_id, sum(actual_attendees) AS actual_attendees, sum(recognized_revenue) AS recognized_revenue, sum(reserved_room_nights) AS reserved_room_nights, sum(pickup_room_nights) AS pickup_room_nights, CAST(sum(pickup_room_nights) AS double) / nullif(sum(reserved_room_nights), 0) AS room_block_pickup_rate FROM serving.analytics.v4_banquet_daily_metrics WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY venue_id ORDER BY venue_id

cases.question: 2026년 6월 시설별 이용량, 순매출, 사고 건수와 중단시간을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT facility_id, sum(usage_count) AS usage_count, sum(facility_guests) AS facility_guests, sum(facility_net_revenue) AS facility_net_revenue, sum(incident_count) AS incident_count, sum(downtime_minutes) AS downtime_minutes FROM serving.analytics.v4_facility_daily_metrics WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY facility_id ORDER BY facility_id

cases.question: 2026년 6월 호텔별 점유 객실당 에너지·수도와 총 자원비를 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT hotel_code, sum(occupied_room_nights) AS occupied_room_nights, sum(energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh, sum(water_m3) AS water_m3, sum(resource_cost) AS resource_cost, CAST(sum(energy_kwh) AS double) / nullif(sum(occupied_room_nights), 0) AS energy_per_occupied_room, CAST(sum(water_m3) AS double) / nullif(sum(occupied_room_nights), 0) AS water_per_occupied_room FROM serving.analytics.v4_resource_daily_metrics WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY hotel_code ORDER BY hotel_code

cases.question: 2026년 6월 공개 호텔명별 객실·F&B·연회·시설 및 통합 운영매출을 보여줘.
cases.sql: SELECT h.public_name, sum(m.room_revenue) AS room_revenue, sum(m.fnb_net_revenue) AS fnb_net_revenue, sum(m.banquet_recognized_revenue) AS banquet_recognized_revenue, sum(m.facility_net_revenue) AS facility_net_revenue, sum(m.total_operating_revenue) AS total_operating_revenue FROM serving.analytics.v4_total_operating_daily_metrics m JOIN serving.reference.v4_hotel_entities h ON m.hotel_code = h.hotel_code WHERE m.business_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND m.business_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY h.public_name ORDER BY h.public_name
